LEARN BEFORE YOU ORDER

Answers buyers search for

What categories can AURVONX support?

Skincare is the core range: brightening, uneven tone, age-well, blemish-prone, barrier and hydration. Haircare covers shampoo, masks, conditioners, oils, serums and scalp care. Styling covers clay, wax, pomade, gel, spray, foam, curl cream and volume formats.

What should I include in my first enquiry?

Send the destination market, product or collection, estimated order quantity, preferred pack, target price positioning and any reference products.

Can I combine products into a set?

Yes. Each collection has a suggested set page. We can coordinate a two-piece, three-piece or broader collection after the exact products, packaging and order scope are confirmed.

How do I request current documentation?

Ask for documentation relevant to your selected project. Scope, validity and applicability are confirmed with the team for the chosen product and destination market.
